children.counts: Simplified 4-count or 8-count walking patterns during line transitions.
children.game_version: A call-and-response spatial game where children form two rings and must zip together into one giant zipper line when the song leader calls out 'Vayia!'

seniors.counts: Standard stepping patterns adapted to gentle counting cycles.
seniors.seated_version: Participants sit in two concentric curved rows, performing arm weaves and shifting forward/backward to mimic the line-merging pattern.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the stepping sequence at a slow tempo with light hand support, executing the shift from two lines to one line with reduced travel distance.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce step size and moderate the speed of transitions between lines.

learning_units.description: Line transition pattern: moving from two concentric circular lines into a single line during designated verse cues.

social_formats.description: Group performance in a circle transitioning between two lines and one line.

movement_profile.footwork: Syrtos-style steps, moving in circular and line paths.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers form two lines inside a circle, merging into one single line and expanding back to two lines at musical intervals.

signature_moves.description: The systematic movement of dancers from two concentric lines in a circle into a single file line, and back out into two lines.
signature_moves.name: Line Merge and Expansion

music_profile.musical_form: Vocal song with distinct structural intervals that signal shifts between single and double line formations.

basic_steps: Form two concentric or parallel lines within a circular formation
Execute Syrtos-style walking and stepping sequences
On designated song cues, merge the two lines into a single line
On subsequent song cues, separate back out into two lines
teaching.formation: Two lines in a circle transitioning into one line and back into two lines.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner friendly circular line transitions following the song structure.
